title: Catalog load is happy-path-only — missing/invalid-JSON error paths and balance fallback untested
evidence:
catalogs.gd _read_json:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
		push_error("[Catalogs] missing file: %s" % path)
		return null
...
	if parsed == null or not parsed is Dictionary:
		push_error("[Catalogs] invalid JSON (expected object) in %s" % path)
		return null

catalogs.gd _load_balance (line 138-139):
		load_errors.append("balance")
		balance = BalanceData.new()   # fall back to compiled defaults (never null)

test_catalogs.gd (the ONLY load_errors/has_errors check):
	check(not c.has_errors(), "load_errors=%s" % str(c.load_errors))
detail: Catalogs surface missing-file/invalid-JSON via load_errors + fall back to compiled balance (never-swallow contract). Only the no-error happy path is asserted — a regression that silently swallows a bad catalog ships undetected.
recommended_fix: Add a test that loads from a deliberately missing/invalid path and asserts load_errors is populated and balance falls back to BalanceData defaults (never null), guarding the never-swallow invariant.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: All 8 suites in game/tests/core/ are REAL (verified, not tautologies): test_qos asserts exact Vector3i partitions (9,8,8)/(3,10,2); test_demand compares same-seed SpawnTriple arrays + a weighted-distribution fraction; test_replay asserts byte-equal fingerprints; test_topology asserts reject reasons + batch atomicity + unchanged state; test_routing asserts delivery + round-robin + visible drops; test_director asserts surge schedule (forecast 700, active 1200/2999, gone 3000); test_parse_gate scans scripts/core for Node + global-RNG. Data catalogs are consistent with every assertion (balance logic_hz=10/weights 1,4,1; packet_types email+streaming; pipe_tiers narrow/standard/wide; node_types residential/content_host/router; demand surge start_tick 1200/duration 1800/lead 600). BUT the suite leaves P0 critical paths uncovered: NetworkHealth win/lose/health-loss 0% (grep NetworkHealth/.won/.lost/meter_pct across game/tests/ = no matches), and QoS priority behavior ~25% (only QoSEngine.allocate covered — promote/demote, drop ladder AC-E9, no-starvation AC-E7, pool-exhaustion AC-E22 untested). game/addons/* are third-party MCP tooling (only .uid files in this diff) — out of scope.
detail: Suite is real and non-tautological; data is consistent + asserted. But P0 is not 100%: health/loss (NetworkHealth) 0% covered, QoS-priority behavior ~25% (only allocate). P0<100% -> FAIL. (Specific behavior-side gaps detailed in chunk-A findings.)
recommended_fix: Add suites for NetworkHealth (breach→drain→lost, surge→win) and QoS priority under contention (promote/demote, drop ladder). That lifts P0 to 100%; the existing real suites already cover the determinism spine, routing, and demand well.
